# ImgNovella: code map

<!-- generated by APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py · 2026-11-08 · code 040fda38626e · regenerate after every change -->

**Read this first, then open only the files it points to.** Line numbers are where definitions start; read
around them with an offset instead of whole files.

**What it is:** Make visual novels in your browser: scenes, characters, branching choices and multiple endings. Share a link or export a playable HTML game to sell. No scripting.
**Live:** https://imgnovella.anvil.app · **Repo:** github.com/arkulinskis/imgnovella · **Layout:** native Anvil Forms · **Deploy:** master
**Guide** (workflow, design rules, product knowledge): `imgnovella/.claude/skills/imgnovella/SKILL.md`

## How to change it

- **New page**: copy a similar `client_code/Pages/<Name>/` (form_template.html + __init__.py), register it in
  `client_code/router.py` (`PAGES`, `_form()`, and `NAV` for the menu). Address = `#name/arg`.
- **New list**: a RepeatingPanel in the page template + `client_code/Items/<Name>/`. **Dialog**: `client_code/Dialogs/<Name>/` opened with `alert(...)`.
- **New server function**: `@anvil.server.callable` in the matching `server_code` module (see *Server*), called with `state.call("name", ...)`.
- **New table/column**: `anvil.yaml` → `db_schema` (the user accepts Anvil's Schema Mismatch alert); update the server-test mock.
- **Drawing/media/canvas**: a JavaScript engine in `theme/assets/` wrapped by a Python module or a `Components/` form.
- **Styles**: `theme/assets/app.css` (colour tokens at the top; rules in APP_MAKER/design/README.md).
- **Check**: `python tools/check.py` → ALL CHECKS PASSED; UI: `python -I tools/ui_test.py` (Docker Desktop running).
- **Deploy**: commit as arkulinskis (+ Co-Authored-By) and `git push` (master unless apps.json says branch-first).
- **Footer** must keep: Submit feedback (Prepsto), Privacy & Terms, Contact developer (arkvital.com), Parent company (addanapp.com).
- **After any change**: `python -I C:/Users/arkvi/Documents/CLAUDE/APP_MAKER/standard/app_map.py imgnovella` refreshes this map.

## Notes

<!-- NOTES: hand-written, kept when the map is regenerated -->
- **Converted to native Forms on branch `forms` (2026-11-08).** The guide named above still describes the old JavaScript
  layout (web/, deploy.py); it is rewritten when the branch is merged. Server code, db_schema and every `#address`
  are unchanged.
- **Three engines stay JavaScript** (theme/assets): `nv-runtime.js` = the player (NovellaRuntime, window.NV). It must stay
  self-contained: Package & sell embeds `NovellaRuntime.toString()` in the exported game. `nv-editor.js` = the whole
  editor (old edit.html + _ed.html, moved unchanged) registered as `UI.page('edit', ...)`; `nv-tools.js` = NVT
  (art list, picture URLs, story check, game packaging). `nv-kit.js` gives the editor the old `UI.*` helpers:
  `UI.api` goes through `window.NV_BRIDGE` (client_code/nv.py `_bridge`), `UI.toast`/`UI.confirm` through
  `NVK.host` (Python notifications and confirm()), and `UI.modal` stays the editor's own HTML dialogs (picture picker,
  playtest, publish, Package & sell). Python reaches the engines only through `client_code/nv.py`.
- **Components:** `Screen` mounts the editor on show and destroys it (last autosave) on hide; the Edit page has
  `waits = True`, so the editor sets `UI_READY` when the novel has loaded. `Player` wraps `NV.mount` (hooks for
  record_play) and stops on hide; `router.show()` also calls `page.leave()`. `Cover` draws `NVT.coverHtml`.
- `state.set_me()` also sets `window.UI.me` (the editor reads the creator's name from it).
- `nv.setup()` sets `window.IMG_API` from `get_api_origin()`: uploaded pictures/sounds are `/img?k=` and `/audio?k=`.
- The Guide, Landing and Pro templates were rendered once from the old pages (static copy); the Guide's mini-game table
  lists NV.GAMES as of the conversion: add a row there when a game is added.
- app.css = template-forms core + design kit + the Sakura Pop skin (button rules aliased to the Anvil Button roles) +
  the editor/tools CSS + page CSS + the Forms layer at the end. Page classes like `.page-edit` come from
  Shell.refresh (`page-<name>` on the frame).
- Tests: `tools/ui/smoke.js` (every address signed out / creator / admin, desktop + phone, incl. every editor tab and
  the player starting). Server tests: tools/testing/test_server.py (plays every demo novel's checks).
<!-- /NOTES -->

## Tools

- `tools/assets.py`: Refresh the theme assets' cache-busting hashes in anvil.yaml (and icons.css).
- `tools/build_icons.py`: Write theme/assets/icons.css from the icon table in theme/assets/lh-kit.js (UI.ICONS).
- `tools/check.py`: Everything that must pass before pushing. Ends with ALL CHECKS PASSED.
- `tools/make_art.py`: Draw ImgNovella's built-in starter art pack as SVG files in theme/assets/ (served at _/theme/demo-*…
- `tools/make_icons.py`: Make the PNG app icons from theme/assets/icon.svg (headless Chrome draws them).
- `tools/ui_test.py`: Run the app for real in the open-source Anvil App Server (Docker) and drive it with headless Chrome.
